question:
A shopkeeper offers the following two discount schemes on the sale of a watch having marked price ₹3,600.

(1) Two successive discounts of 15%.:

(2) A discount of 10% followed by a discount of 20%.

What is the difference between the selling price of the watch in case (1) and case (2)?
solution:

Marked price= Rs. 3600

Two successive discounts of 15%.

A discount of 10% followed by a discount of 20%

⇒ Effective Discount = 30 - 2.25 = 27.75%

Case (2)

Effective Discount = 10 + 20 - (10 × 20)/100

⇒ Effective Discount = 30 - 2 = 28%

The difference in percentage = 28% - 27.75% = 0.25%

**∴ The difference between the selling price of the watch is rupees 9.**
